principle: A registry entry describes evidence quality; it does not itself grant network access.

sources.name: Wikipedia
sources.role: Orientation for an existing AION question; every answer cites the specific page.
sources.limitations: Not sufficient by itself for high-stakes or disputed claims.

sources.name: Official and primary sources
sources.role: Future adapter target for research papers, public institutions, and official documentation.
sources.limitations: Requires a source-specific retrieval and citation adapter before use.

sources.name: Audience and social signals
sources.role: May raise questions or evaluate creative resonance.
sources.limitations: Never establishes a factual belief alone.

sources.name: YouTube public video metadata
sources.role: Discovery leads for AION's existing curiosity questions; only public title, description, channel, and URL are recorded.
sources.limitations: Requires YOUTUBE_DATA_API_KEY. Never downloads captions, media, or comments; a video is not factual evidence without corroboration.
